title: work-order-closed, version 1
description: Example message type (exchange contract 1.0, section 4): the installer reports that a work order is closed. Direction IN, endpoint_logico 'installer', ref_externa the work order number. The receiving package defines the deftemplate work-order-closed with the slots wf-id, work-order, closed-at, result and notes.

work-order.description: Work order number in the installer's system (also the row's ref_externa).

result.description: Outcome of the work order. A SYMBOL slot in the receiving package.

notes.description: Free text from the technician. Optional; the slot default applies when absent.
